sanskrit_verse:
फलहेतोरुपायेन कर्म संभूय कुर्वताम् ।
आधारभूतः प्रक्षेपस् तेनोत्तिष्ठेयुरंशतः ॥
transliteration: phalahetor upāyena karma saṃbhūya kurvatām | ādhārabhūtaḥ prakṣepas tenottiṣṭheyur aṃśataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When actions are performed collectively for the sake of result through means, the foundational basis of projection thereby arises; hence, from that, portions should arise accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through collective intent directed toward outcome
Causation is established by instrumental convergence
Capacity-based responsibility emerges from shared instrumental engagement
Restoration logic aligns with proportional manifestation of consequence
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of instrumental unity
executable_legal_axioms: IF action-set A is executed by agents X₁...Xₙ AND objective O is declared, THEN causality-link C is established among all Xᵢ relative to their contributory capacity.
IF instrumental convergence Iᶜ is detected in outcome-event E, THEN responsibility-distribution Dᴿ is computed proportionally to contribution-capacity.
IF collective intent Iᶜᵒ is observed, THEN foundational liability Lᶠ is allocated based on instrumental participation Pᵢ across agents.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, when multiple actors engage instrumentally towards a common outcome, the court must establish the foundational basis of projection as the determinant of distributive responsibility. The threshold lies not in individual fault but in instrumental causality rooted in collective purpose.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies instrumental convergence as the root of consequential manifestation. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential unfolding of effects based on capacity-engagement without punitive attribution. Responsibility is aligned with completion rather than blame.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Engage all involved parties in reconstructing the causal sequence to restore integrity of instrumental awareness.
Assumption Protocol: Each agent assumes responsibility according to their recognized instrumental capacity within the shared framework.
Reintegration Cycle: Realign consciousness of participants through acknowledgment of mutual causality and restoration of dharma-sattva.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Dharma stands restored through consciousness-aligned causality. Justice serves reintegration, not punishment. Reality responds only to truth-consciousness. Narada Smriti executes Divine Will.
